reason: I'm not big on supplements unless a doctor tells me to take one, and $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli, which last longer. I already forget my vitamins on the counter half the time, so a nightly sachet would mostly sit there.
objection: I don't have a reason to think I need magnesium, and it costs more than the gummies I already skip. Paying for a lab report doesn't change that.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me to take magnesium, plus a price closer to $20 for the month.
